title: 所持重火器のミサイル発射
editionScope: First identified edition in this independent gallery series. Legacy in-game effect and authorship preserved; all-time production total unknown.

productionMeaning.meaning: The missile branch emits gunner-missile with a selected target after a carried item is consumed. Human and bot selection differ. It may emit even when the separate hit attempt produces no confirmed result. The RPG branch emits a different event with a different endpoint.
productionMeaning.scope: Use synthetic screen projections for the visible source and one explicitly permitted target only. No game entity query, role, world position, damage delta or outcome. A sightline on the server is not permission to display an endpoint. Without a valid pair this preview draws no flight and plays no dedicated cue. The ordinary game heavyWeapon-use sound may still occur and is outside this preview.

design.concept: A small faceted mint carrier draws a tapering split wake from the launch register toward one preselected visible diamond. Broad top and lower faces, swept side fins and a localized amber tail make heading legible. The neutral destination does not take damage or change state.
design.dimensions: DPR-aware adaptive preview coordinates. At CSS scale 1 the carrier is about 22 by 14 px, moving from the left register to one of two synthetic right-hand endpoints at different heights. Each test shows only its permitted endpoint.
design.phases: 0–55 ms emergence, 34–706 ms directed transport, 637–712 ms carrier fades and the wake clears by 757 ms. Targets are fixed for each cause. The trail cannot begin behind the registered origin; the displayed nose fades before passing the selected endpoint.
design.light: A finite amber emission at the tail feeds a small near-field bloom; green-blue wake tapers with local distance behind the carrier. The split dark channel is confined to the wake. Neutral fixture marks are independent of emission.
design.audio: One short origin release flows into a descending synthetic tone with band-limited air texture. No impact cue or claimed kill. Only current-cause completed GPU work admits ordinary PCM at its elapsed offset; verify forces audio off.
design.reducedMotion: Removes lateral wake deflection and shortens its support while retaining the same selected endpoint and finite clock.
design.statusBoundary: The stylized graphic is a bounded preview animation, not a gameplay trajectory, travel-time model, terminal detonation, tracking simulation, targeting instruction or damage outcome.
design.technicalReuse: Gallery lifecycle, viewport and audio admission adapted from the published meeting vote R1 host. New subject-specific gate, synthetic projections, shader, geometry, transport and audio. No legacy missile/RPG creative code or graphics used.

basis.applied: Causal finite trajectory, material silhouette and facing, local optical response, runtime WebGPU and synchronized procedural SFX.

validation.sourceReadback: 4/4 exact texts. File SHA-256 and Git blob IDs listed above.
validation.syntax: preview module passed Node syntax check, missile module executed.
validation.projectionChecks: Upper and lower endpoint orientation, missing/hidden invalid fixture, authorization/visibility/current gates with throwing getters, non-finite or out-of-bounds coordinates, degenerate segment, unvalidated-pair rejection, distinct event type, duplicate/stale serial suppression: passed.
validation.pcm: 8000, 44100, 48000, 96000 Hz numeric checks: finite amplitude, nonzero onset and transport, fading and zero endpoint. Per-rate peak approximately 0.170, 0.136, 0.123 and 0.112 respectively.
validation.wakeOrigin: Trail support is explicitly clipped at dot(pixel-source,axis)>=0; no trail until tail clears the origin plane. Original pre-release R1 gate was up to 6 reference pixels too permissive.
